prompt: You are testing a login form. Name one edge-case input for the email field that a naive validator often gets wrong. Reply in one short phrase.

scorer.expect: Award 1.0 if the answer names a genuine tricky-but-valid or tricky-invalid email edge case (e.g. plus-addressing, subdomains, unicode/IDN, quoted local part, very long address, trailing dot, empty string). Award 0.0 if it is generic ("a wrong email") or not an edge case.
